purpose: Design of the agenda display layer (agenda_render.py) that generates agenda.html from agenda.json, including status display, change highlighting and automatic tab refresh.
summary: HTML adoption rationale and first display via the open command by consult
HTML template structure: summary table, item cards, definition list of fields, generated-notice
Change indication by a single gutter dot instead of full card background
Severity badge using pastel colors plus text labels (WCAG 1.4.1), key from config.severity_field
Field-level change highlighting via data-changed driven by last_changed_fields
CSS selector responsibilities with concrete values deferred to implementation
Derived status column: unstarted, in progress, settled from background/essence/decision
Auto-refresh via content_version comparison using script src swapping on file://
Scroll position preservation with sessionStorage across reloads
Test design and reused existing components
tasks: Adjusting severity badge or change highlighting
title: DES-077 agenda 表示層設計書
